silent_decisions.operation: pick the raw crowdstorming CSV as the data source, read in as-is with UTF-8 encoding

misalignments.decision: derive a per-player career goals total from the player list and merge it back in as a new column
misalignments.claim: a variable for each player's average number of goals per game was computed
misalignments.note: claim says average goals per game; code derives a career goals total and never divides by games

misalignments.decision: mean-center the implicit and explicit bias scores using the average over non-excluded referee-countries (the corresponding sd is computed but not applied)
misalignments.claim: height, weight, meanIAT, and meanExp variables were standardized
misalignments.note: claim says meanIAT/meanExp were standardized; code only mean-centers them and does not divide by the sd
